title: Elixir of Elven Elegance
summary: Until Long Rest, gain 33 ft of movement speed, Superior Darkvision, and immunity to Charmed.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain 33 ft of movement speed, Superior Darkvision, and immunity to Charmed.
fields.Acquisition: Trade elf or drow blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
